Class KnockdownManager

java.lang.Object
stawa.vitalstrike.systems.KnockdownManager
public final class KnockdownManager extends Object
Knockdown system: lethal damage puts a player into a timed "downed" state instead of killing them. Others (or a Vital Awakening item) can revive them before the timer runs out.
